sloka: स तु स्रेष्ठैर्गुणैर्युक्तः प्रजानां पार्थिवात्मजः ।बहिश्चर इव प्राणो बभूव गुणतः प्रियः ॥२-१-१९॥
transliteration: sa tu sreṣṭhairguṇairyuktaḥ prajānāṁ pārthivātmajaḥ ।bahiścara iva prāṇo babhūva guṇataḥ priyaḥ ॥2-1-19॥

translations.english: Bestowed with such excellent qualities, the prince (Rama) became a favourite of his subjects. He was like their vital life outside their bodies.
